name: kg-suite-decision-card-portal
description: Buyer-facing static HTML viewer for AI Procurement Decision Cards. Drop in a Decision Card URL → renders a procurement-review-friendly summary: data tiers · retention envelope · vault contract type · signature verified status · 3-axis posture (if DefenseTech). Deploys to decisions.kineticgain.com. Replaces 'read raw JSON' for non-engineer reviewers.
